technical: 24-second run with 240 sampled records across eight variants and five phase receipt types

limitations: The held screenshots are not bound to exact GPU receipt frames; visual observations do not establish every-frame GPU completion.
R6 comparison used the prior public version under a different route; frames are not proven same-GPU-frame matched, so no quantified improvement or regression is claimed.
The support-envelope animation changes shard orientation and support through contacts; it is not a rigid-body solver and does not establish angular-momentum conservation.
Only the sampled mineral-water holds were visually reviewed; other variants, complete visual lifetime, normal audio listening, formal public-parent replay and game integration remain unverified.
